items: [Latest Android OS Tablet] - Latest tablet certified by GMS with Android OS operating system. Android tablets come with Google Play installed and support social apps like Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Tiktok and more. Ideal for watching videos, chatting online, reading eBooks and more.

[2+2GB Expand RAM and 32GB ROM] - 2GB RAM + 2GB Expandable Memory to run most Android apps, Equipped with 1.5GHz low power quad-core processor, 7’ touchscreen IPS 178° viewing angle LCD display, Hundreds of apps can be installed.Micro SD Expandable up to 512GB (not included). Micro SD expandable up to 512GB (included) for easy storage of videos, music, photos and more.

[Portable & Lightweight & Protective Case] - NEWISION Touch 7 Android Tablet PC has an elegant and delicate design with a slim and lightweight body, making it more convenient to carry. You can carry it in your bag or pocket, moreover, this Android tablet comes with a high quality protective case, no need to hold it in your hand, you can put it on your kitchen countertop, desktop, outdoor or leisure place and use it anywhere you want.

【3500mAh Long-lasting Battery】- This 7 inch Tablet equipped with 3500 mAh lithium battery with a 1024 x 600 brilliant HD IPS display and low power consumption CPU, enables up to 6 hours of web browsing and up to 4 hours of video playback.

【Perfect for Daily Use】The Android OS tablet is designed with a lightweight and slim body, allowing you to enjoy eBooks, movies, TV shows and music effortlessly while travelling or on business. Package Contents: tablet, USB-C cable, protective case, user manual.
